comment: EFE M13 trust-store. Loaders try each key in `keys` until one validates the manifest signature. Pin tested by `test_m13_pubkeys_trust_store_present`.

keys.comment: DEV-ONLY key used to sign the M13 sample placeholder bundles shipped in the repo. NEVER active for signing in production. The corresponding privkey lives in `scripts/release/dev_signing_key.b64`. Audit fix M13-A7 (LOW) — pre-fix valid_until was set to 2099-12-31 (75-year window) ; post-fix uses a realistic 5-year horizon (2030-12-31) matching prod-grade key rotation conventions.

Production signing key Q1 2026 — placeholder. The real key will be uploaded to the trust-store at first prod bundle release (post-D40 GA). Marked `active_for_signing=false` until then so loaders refuse signatures from this key_id.
